name: Layout bounds cache telemetry

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: Taffy layout bounds cache telemetry in wide DataTable WebGPU frame
hypothesisMarkdown: Instrument `TaffyLayoutEngine::layout_bounds` to distinguish direct cache hits from recursive parent-origin cache hits and misses. The wide DataTable workload may expose repeated or recursively expensive bounds resolution that justifies a later single-mechanism optimization; this experiment changes diagnostics only and makes no production-path change when `rayx_diagnostics` is disabled.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Before source edits, run three fresh headed WebGPU Test Suite benchmark processes with one worker at DPR 1 and DPR 2 and save raw output outside `.agentx`. Add exactly four bounded diagnostic counters at indices 16..19 through gpui, Scene, gpui_wgpu, gpui_web, and the focused TypeScript fixture; update the fixed 20-value Rust oracle. Then run 456 gpui tests, two sequential 52/52 gpui_wgpu diagnostics suites, native checks with diagnostics off/on, single-thread WASM diagnostics check, warning-denied Clippy, package formatting, and three fresh candidate browser processes. Require exact existing-counter parity, exact new-counter invariants, no terminal errors, and no material product regression. Any gate failure reverts immediately.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: All validation gates pass; existing renderer, Taffy tree-shape, traversal, and final-scroll counters remain identical; new counters quantify total bounds calls, direct cache hits, recursive parent-origin hits, and recursive parent-origin misses at both DPRs. Accept only as measurement infrastructure when it yields stable actionable evidence without materially degrading acknowledged throughput or paced p95.

playwright: Three fresh checkpoint processes passed both DPR 1 and DPR 2 with one worker; six samples and zero terminal errors were captured under artifacts-temp/agentx-experiments/gpux-maximum-performance/23-layout-bounds-cache-telemetry/.
rayx: The first candidate gate, cargo fmt --check for gpui, failed on the fixed 20-value diagnostics oracle's line wrapping. Atomic discipline required immediate revert before compilation or runtime validation.
